waxy.toward: Waxy airbrushed skin, plastic-smooth and poreless, heavily retouched, glossy rendered look.
waxy.away: Natural unretouched skin with visible pores, fine lines and tiny hairs, raw photograph.

blur.toward: Shallow depth of field, the background blurred into soft bokeh.
blur.away: Deep focus, everything sharp from front to back.

tests.woman: A close-up portrait photograph of a woman of thirty-five with brown hair, looking at the camera, in soft window light.
tests.man: A close-up portrait photograph of a man of sixty with grey stubble, looking at the camera, outdoors on an overcast day.
tests.half: A photograph of a woman of fifty in a green linen shirt standing in a kitchen, seen from the waist up.
tests.fox: A photograph of a red fox standing in a snowy pine forest.
